project: An Intelligent Multi-Factor Route Selection and Adaptive Recovery Framework for DSR-Based Mobile Ad Hoc Networks Using Random Forest and XGBoost

Manet.notes: Direct MANET telemetry plus geometry-derived connectivity metadata from the topology CSV were retained with provenance.

Mobility.notes: Mobility position files provide x/y/speed; these were retained without fabricating direction or velocity.

Link_Quality.notes: Wireless link quality values were directly present; no attempt was made to infer absent metrics.

Network_Performance.notes: Performance metrics were directly represented in the raw CSVs; cumulative and per-flow values were preserved as-is.

Congestion.notes: Congestion and resource-allocation indicators were present in the packet-level simulation CSV.

DSR_Routing.notes: No DSR-specific route-state fields were found; the generic protocol field exists but does not prove DSR route events.

Failure_Recovery.notes: Failure indicators were present, but no explicit recovery or route-repair field was found in the raw data.

unavailable_factors: DSR-specific route metadata: route_id, route_path, route_lifetime, rreq/rrep/rerr counts, route repair times, route discovery times, recovery_time, recovery_success, alternate_route
Explicit DSR route events for RREQ/RREP/RERR were unavailable in the raw CSVs
Explicit route-recovery metrics were unavailable in the raw CSVs

data_quality_notes.duplicate_rows: No duplicates were removed automatically; provenance was preserved by source_file and original identifiers.
data_quality_notes.missing_values: Original missing values were retained in the extracted metadata; blank cells indicate absence in the raw source.
data_quality_notes.incompatible_experiments: Different raw files were not merged blindly; each category retains source provenance.

topology_included.notes: Included as a geometry-derived topology source for connectivity and adjacency metadata; not treated as RF or DSR route-state data.
